deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Which weather has the strongest evidence for moving Interior mule deer in fall?
back: Snow and cold. They trigger the move to winter range (85%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: What is a cold front?
back: The edge of colder, denser air pushing under and replacing warmer air (80%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Wind before and after a cold front?
back: Before: south or southwest. After: west or northwest, colder, pressure rising (70%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Penn State, 30 winter storms: deer before the storm?
back: No real change in movement before storms (80%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Penn State, 30 winter storms: deer during the storm?
back: They moved less during the storm (80%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Glass the calm after a storm: fact or tip?
back: A tip. No study here measured movement right after a front.

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Barometric pressure evidence for deer movement?
back: Weak and mixed. Do not cancel a hunt for it (Tip).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: What explained most change in movement in one Oklahoma collar study?
back: Temperature (65%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Time of day versus weather: which matters more for deer activity?
back: Time of day. Weather effects were smaller than the daily rhythm (65%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Snow depth: when do mule deer struggle and when do they leave?
back: Trouble near 30 cm, leave slopes near 50 cm (75%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Wyoming mule deer: what set migration timing?
back: Temperature and snowfall. Rifle season added only about 2% for does (85%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: What best explained duck numbers in the Missouri weather study?
back: A cumulative weather severity index: freezing days, snow depth and snow cover days (75%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: When does most BC Interior duck migration end?
back: Late November, with freeze up (75%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Canada geese on stormy days?
back: Increased flights through the whole day (70%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Pheasants in worse weather?
back: They go deeper into thick cover (70%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Chukar in heavy snow?
back: They move lower and onto south facing slopes (75%).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: First step when reading a forecast for hunting?
back: Wind: direction and speed for dawn, midday and dusk (Tip).

deck: Weather fronts and game movement: what the evidence says
front: Memory hook SCRaP?
back: Snow and cold, Rut, and Pressure from hunters move deer most.

deck: Hunting pressure: how people push game and where it goes

back: They chose security habitat away from motorized routes (85%).

deck: Hunting pressure: how people push game and where it goes

deck: Hunting pressure: how people push game and where it goes

deck: Hunting pressure: how people push game and where it goes

deck: Hunting pressure: how people push game and where it goes

deck: Hunting pressure: how people push game and where it goes

deck: Hunting pressure: how people push game and where it goes

deck: Hunting pressure: how people push game and where it goes

back: Do not block or harass a legal hunter or trapper (99%).

deck: Hunting pressure: how people push game and where it goes

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: Four ways animals move in BC?
back: Long distance (ducks, geese), up and down (mule deer, elk, moose, dusky grouse), short shifts (white tails), stay home (quail, chukar, ruffed grouse).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: SIMDeer: share of collared mule deer that migrated?

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: SIMDeer: average migration distance?
back: 47.2 km a year on the current page; 55 km in the 2020 update (85%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: Longest SIMDeer migration?
back: 102 km straight line, Apex Mountain area to west of Aspen Grove, 1 to 12 May (85%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: Do mule deer change routes each year?
back: No. Most choose nearly the same path both ways (85%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: When do collared mule deer return to winter range?
back: October to November; one year nearly all by mid October (85%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: Which leaves the high country last: deer, elk or moose?
back: Moose (85%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: Moose and snow?
back: Little trouble to 40 cm; often winter in 50 cm or more (85%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: Studied Kamloops winter range elevation?
back: Below about 760 m (80%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: White tailed deer seasonal moves?
back: Short: along major valleys or across from north slopes in summer to south slopes in winter (85%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: Snow geese on the Fraser delta come from where?
back: Wrangel Island, about 5,000 km (80%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: When do Fraser delta snow geese shift to the Skagit?
back: Late December (70 to 75%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: Interior ducks when plateau ponds freeze?
back: They move to open valley water and the coast (65%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: Dusky grouse in fall?
back: Move from open breeding areas into dense conifers, usually uphill (70%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: Fraser delta waterfowl food demand runs which months?
back: September to April (80%).

deck: Migration routes in BC: deer, elk, moose and birds
front: Memory hook 74, 47, 102?
back: 74% migrate, 47 km a year, 102 km the record (85%).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: What does Interior winter range look like?
back: Steep south and west faces, broken rock, shrubs, old Douglas fir, in the dry forest zone (85%).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: What is snow interception cover?
back: Big conifer crowns that catch snow so deer can walk and feed below (80%).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: Under what law are Ungulate Winter Ranges made?
back: Sections 9 and 12 of the Government Actions Regulation, Forest and Range Practices Act (90%).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: What does order u-3-003 control?
back: Primary forest activities: timber harvest, silviculture, roads. Keep snow interception cover (99%).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: Does a UWR order close hunting?
back: Not by itself. Hunting rules come from the synopsis (85%, my reading).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: Approved UWR polygons around Heffley Creek?
back: None found in the layer query; nearest mule deer orders south toward Merritt and on the North Okanagan side (90%).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: Dewdrop Rosseau Creek WMA is winter range for what?
back: Mule deer and California bighorn sheep (90%). Map C16: open lines only for vehicles.

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: Before hunting a conservation land or WMA?
back: Contact the regional office (99%, page 9).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: Grazing lease with cattle on it?
back: No hunting without the consent of the lessee or occupant (99%, page 9).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: Region 3 mule deer bucks from 1 November in your MUs?
back: 4 points or better, to 10 December (99%).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: Item 25, page 11?
back: No power boat, aircraft, motor vehicle or other machine to herd or harass wildlife (99%).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: What disturbs wintering deer most, per agency fact sheets?
back: Dogs, then ATVs and mountain bikes, then people off trail (70%).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: Why glass winter range instead of walking it?
back: Each flight in snow costs fat and feeding time (70%).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally

back: Season and class, No Shooting or closed area, land owner, vehicle closure (Tip).

deck: Winter ranges: what they are and how to hunt near them legally
front: Snowmobile for hunting closure in MU 3-28?
back: 1 April to 14 December (99%).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather
front: Louisiana mallards: distance between day and night sites?

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather
front: Missouri mallards: average daily local move?
back: About 3 km (2 miles); most under 13 km (65%).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather
front: When do Dutch GPS mallards commute?
back: At dusk and dawn between a day roost and night feeding sites (65%).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather
front: Canada geese feeding flights?
back: Early morning and late afternoon; more all day in storms (70%).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather
front: Ducks land facing which way?
back: Into the wind (70%).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather
front: Where should the wind be at your blind?
back: At your back or quartering from behind (70%).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather
front: Dabbler versus diver takeoff?
back: Dabblers jump straight up; divers patter across the water (80%).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather
front: Legal hours for ducks and geese?
back: 30 minutes before sunrise to 30 minutes after sunset (99%).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather
front: Heffley Creek legal duck start on 15 October 2026?
back: About 6:52 (sunrise about 7:22) (85%).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather

back: Not from a moving boat with a motor or sail; beached or anchored is fine (99%, 95%).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather
front: Scouting rule of thumb (Tip)?
back: Watch the evening flight from far away, hunt the morning.

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather

back: No. Hunt the feed and rest the roost (Tip).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather

back: Wigeon and Canada geese (90%).

deck: Waterfowl daily flights: roost, feed, loaf, weather

back: About 15 km (Tip, from the 3 to 15 km range).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain

back: Feed early, hide midday, feed late, roost at dusk (75%).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain

back: Dense trees or shrubs (75%).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain

back: Feeding on slopes; on cool nights they may roost on warmer south slopes (70%).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain

back: Shady slopes, draws, dust baths and water (70%).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain
front: Chukar late afternoon?
back: Moving back toward steeper roosts (70%).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain

back: Feed and pick grit early and late, cover midday (75%).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain
front: Dusky grouse breeding heights in BC?
back: Many records 1,500 to 2,250 m (85%).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain
front: Spruce grouse food?
back: Needles of pine or spruce (85%).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain
front: Pheasant first light?
back: Grit on roadsides, then feeding about 8 am (70%).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain

back: The densest, thickest cover nearby (70%).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain

back: Region 8 MUs 8-1 to 8-15 and 8-21 to 8-26, 1 October to 30 November, 10 a day (99%).

deck: Upland birds' daily pattern by terrain
front: Region 3 grouse limits?
back: 5 of each kind, 10 in total a day, 10 September to 30 November (99%).

back: Dust bowls, droppings under roosts, tracks, feathers.
